title: Webmercs and Netset
desc: B2B ordering platforms resellers use with distributors

lessons.title: What is a reseller ordering platform?

pages.h: A shop front for the reseller
pages.t: Webmercs and Netset make e-commerce platforms: software a reseller uses for its own webshop and purchasing. Both are built around integration, so the shop can connect to distributors and vendors, instead of staff typing everything by hand.
g: Software that runs a webshop: catalogue, prices, basket and orders.

pages.t: Netset says direct distributor integration gives real-time pricing and stock updates and highly reduced transaction costs. Webmercs lists stock updates from vendors, order processing, and links to ERP and accounting systems. One place to check, order and hand data on.
g: The system a company uses to run finance, stock and orders.
A live link between two systems so data moves automatically.

pages.t: Webmercs is made by Data Design AS in Oslo, Norway, with customers in Norway, Sweden, Denmark and Finland. Netset, based in Malmö, Sweden, sells its Nettailer platform to IT and telecom resellers. They are competing platforms, not one product. Allnet is not the platform, it is a distributor that can be connected.

quiz.q: What is Webmercs or Netset in this context?
o: A distributor that ships IT products
A webshop platform a reseller uses, connectable to distributors
quiz.w: They are software platforms for webshops and purchasing. They do not hold stock themselves in this picture.

quiz.q: Which benefit does Netset state for direct distributor integration?
quiz.w: Netset says direct integration gives real-time pricing and stock updates and reduces transaction costs.
Webmercs is made by Data Design AS, based in Oslo.

o: Allnet is a distributor whose products and stock a reseller's platform can show
Allnet is a reseller using Webmercs
quiz.w: Allnet is a distributor. A reseller's platform can be connected to a distributor so that distributor's range shows there.

lessons.title: Platforms in practice and what to tell a reseller

pages.t: Nettailer comes in tiers for different reseller sizes. The main difference is how many distributors can be connected: Essential one, Business up to three, Professional five or more. Netset says onboarding takes about 10 days to a first order. Distbox is the separate product for distributors and manufacturers.
g: A package level, from basic to advanced.

pages.t: Webmercs says it aims to automate any exchange that can be done electronically. Structured product and price files from vendors can be imported, with vendor requirements in separate guidelines. Webshops can also hand orders to an ERP or accounting system and send product files to price-comparison sites. Exact set-up per distributor is a technical job.
g: A data file listing products, prices and stock, sent in a fixed format.

pages.h: What to say to a reseller
pages.t: Keep it simple: if you already use Webmercs or Netset, ask which platform and offer to be connected so they see our range and stock in their shop. Do not promise a date or features. The set-up details are agreed with the platform and your manager.
g: Linked so the distributor's data shows in the reseller's platform.

quiz.q: What mainly separates Netset's Nettailer tiers for resellers?
o: The number of distributors that can be integrated
quiz.w: Netset states Essential supports one distributor, Business up to three, Professional five or more.

quiz.q: A reseller says they use Webmercs. What is a good first step?
o: Tell them to switch to Netset
Ask which platform they use and offer to be connected so our range shows there
quiz.w: Ask and offer the connection. The lessons do not support promising dates or features.

quiz.q: Which is the distributor-side product from Netset?
quiz.w: Distbox is for distributors and manufacturers; the other Nettailer tiers are for resellers.
